name: Pi-hole and Unbound
description: This is a custom pihole and unbound setup.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Ftlconf webserver api password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-pihole-unbound application
services:
  # Service name: app
  # The `app` service definition
  app:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-pihole-unbound
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: bigbeartechworld/big-bear-pihole-unbound:2026.10.0@sha256:ffa5aaea39e546ff18eac9fc9b16bdb69053c2168502d70c5bafa4af334b8634
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      TZ: "America/Chicago"
      FTLCONF_webserver_api_password: ${SECRET_FTLCONF_WEBSERVER_API_PASSWORD}
      FTLCONF_dns_upstreams: "127.0.0.1#5353" # Use Unbound IPs delimited by ; ex: 8.8.8.8;8.8.4.4
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local /DATA/AppData/$AppID/etc directory to /etc/pihole/ inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/etc:/etc/pihole/
      # Mounting the local /DATA/AppData/$AppID/dnsmasq.d directory to /etc/dnsmasq.d inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/dnsmasq.d:/etc/dnsmasq.d/
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      - "67:67/udp"
      - "${APP_PORT}:80/tcp"
      - "10443:443/tcp"
    networks:
      # Define the network for pihole-unbound
      - pihole-unbound-network # Name of the network used by pihole-unbound
# Define the networks section
networks:
  # Define the pihole-unbound-network
  pihole-unbound-network:
    # Set the network driver to bridge
    driver: bridge
